items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Fidgey McGrath. Fulton McGrath. And Bunny [Berigan]. Dick McDonough and Carl Kress.

ctx.x: That gave it so much drive.

Chauncey Morehouse was playing drums. Later I worked with all those guys. Chauncey was a drummer. I got to know Chauncey very well. I had a lot of them . . . in one rehearsal I have in my book, Chauncey’s in the band. Fidgey McGrath. Fulton McGrath. And Bunny [Berigan]. Dick McDonough and Carl Kress.
When you got to New York, and a lot of those guys were in the studio scene as well . . .
